Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting
headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating consistent with concussion. The
mechanism of injury and the force involved are well matched to the symptoms described.
Initial examination documented post-concussive findings, and imaging obtained during
the course of care clearly confirmed the injury. Over five outpatient visits,
management followed a typical course of symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular
rest guidance, and graded activity advice. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit
frequnecy was tapered as recovery progressed. The patient reports a remote, minor
strain in the same region years earlier, which resolved completely without residaul
limitation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated
charges. Ongoing follow-up is recommended only if new or worsening symptoms develop.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
